Found by the pre-cutover config audit (2026-08-09, read-only, source-only — core01 NOT contacted). Four related core01-deploy-path blockers; grouped because they share the fix surface (scripts/core01-deploy-local.sh + core01-package-runtime.sh + a versioned plist).

## B2 — the core01 launch plist is not in the repo
docs/deploy/ has only the NATS-worker and qmd-sync templates; `fd -H -e plist` finds NO com.rico.open-brain.plist. core01-deploy-local.sh:141 kickstarts a plist it never installs and whose contents (entrypoint, env delivery, ThrottleInterval, migration gating) are unversioned. The allowlist question you asked cannot be answered on paper because the launch shape is not in git. FIX: land com.rico.open-brain.plist as a docs/deploy template like the NATS worker precedent.

## B3 — no revision proof, no feature signal
local-clone-deploy.sh:22-27 says outright core01's script lacks the revision proof. core01-deploy-local.sh only has wait_for_health() (69-82): 10×2s = 20s poll of the :3100 FRONT. This is the exact 2026-08-02 failure the clone was hardened against (local-clone-deploy.sh:126-136): a process that throws on config and dies, launchd holding it down past the poll window, /health answered by the never-stopped old process. core01's window is shorter than the clone's and far shorter than a 30s throttle — strictly MORE exposed. .deployed-revision is written (core01-package-runtime.sh:29-36) and never verified. Multi-worker: wait_for_health hits the aggregate front, so a front answering over a dead worker reads green. FIX: port check_new_process_serving (local-clone-deploy.sh:138-196), widen the poll past ThrottleInterval, add a feature-live /health assertion, and check each worker port (3101/3102) directly.

## B4 — deploy tars the working tree, not the commit
core01-package-runtime.sh:12-27 tars \$REPO_DIR. The ref gate (verify_deploy_ref, 44-70) only checks HEAD is an ancestor of origin/main — a git-history claim, silent on the working tree — and is a no-op outside CI (51-56 return 0 with no DEPLOY_PROVIDER). A dirty file on the runner ships to production with a passing gate; an operator running it by hand gets no ref check at all. FIX: git archive the committed revision, or a hard dirty-tree refusal.

## SHOULD-FIX 5 — in-place perl -pi edit of the operator env file
core01-deploy-local.sh:127-131 rewrites /Users/rico/.config/open-brain/env (holds all AUTH_TOKEN_*) in place, unbacked-up; a mid-write failure truncates it and .previous covers only the runtime. Also a silent adjustment (announces nothing). FIX: back up the env file first; announce the change.

## SHOULD-FIX 6 — migration/rollback story
Ordering is correct (migrate before swap, aborts with old runtime intact) and migrate.ts is ledger-based/transactional/idempotent — re-running is safe, verified no CONCURRENTLY-in-transaction hazard. Residual: no advisory lock (concurrency held only by run-two-worker.ts:44 giving worker 0 the migrate flag — safety by unversioned plist convention, ties to B2); and rollback is code-only — a forward-incompatible migration makes .previous restore code that can't run the migrated schema. FIX: advisory lock in migrate.ts; a documented forward-fix plan for non-backward-compatible migrations.
